directional_BBB_transport_and_intact_car: CRITICAL DIRECTIONAL MISMATCH. Pruenster Figs3/5 demonstrate intact CCL2 basolateral->apical and NO increased apical->basolateral soluble CCL2 flux in MDCK/HUVEC. Minten Fig5: CCL2 and CCL5 reverse (brain->blood) transport in TNF-treated pMBMEC; ELISA not sequence-level intact proof. NO evidence for luminal->abluminal engineered peptide delivery.
structural_and_epitope_feasibility: Human CCL7-bound full-length 7TM ACKR1 cryo-EM PDB 8JPS, 3.65 A (Saha Fig4); binding mainly N-terminal Glu46-Leu57 CRS1 and extracellular TM6/7/ECL3, Cys51-Cys276(7.25) disulfide; shallow CRS1, limited CRS2, proximal N-terminus unresolved and Nb52 density absent. Baseline mouse-human extracellular identity 52.17%, species/glycan/allele issues; requires membrane and native RBC/non-RBC context. Dimer arrangement may be nonphysiological.
functional_safety_liabilities: HIGH IMMUNE FUNCTION CAUTION. Endothelial ACKR1 chemokine export and apical presentation promotes neutrophil/monocyte trafficking (Pruenster Figs6-8), and vascular ACKR1 contributes to EAE disease (Minten Fig9). CCL7 has no measurable canonical Gi/Gs/Gq, GRK or beta-arrestin coupling in Saha assays, but exploratory phosphoproteomics/CD82 associations prevent claim of zero signalling. Avoid chemokine displacement and inflammatory gradient disruption.

Membrane/caveolar context essential.
functional_safety_liabilities: HIGH / noncompensatory concern: P-selectin-mediated neutrophil adhesion, activated platelets and thromboinflammation. Selp global knockout attenuates 24h poststroke IgG/Gd permeability and PMN infiltration (Jin 2010); peptide that agonizes or blocks physiological binding may alter stroke BBB protection, hemostasis or leukocyte recruitment. Knockout ≠ peptide toxicity or safety.

L57 in-vivo intact parenchymal peptide or therapeutic cargo not demonstrated. LRP1 physiological A-beta efflux is opposite direction, separate endpoint.
structural_and_epitope_feasibility: Mature 600-kDa LRP1 alpha/beta chains; large disulfide/calcium/glycosylated ectodomain, four extracellular ligand-binding clusters. L57 CL4 recombinant domain S3332-D3779; cluster IV subrepeat-level epitope unknown; Angiopep-2 binding site not precisely mapped, CL2 preference qualitative. Source mouse-human ECD identity 98.05% (preserved); membrane, ligands, Ca, receptor cleavage/processing and glycan state essential for structure modeling.

LRP1 involved in A-beta clearance and BBB integrity (Google Sheet leads not fulltext adjudicated). Rodrigues found L57 near-control 4h MTT on primary rat BMVEC and PEA10 at 3-30uM; no chronic, BBB-barrier or animal safety. A7 (NOT A2) shows concentration-dependent 4h MTT impairment.
